answer.text: Even insider information is in prices — no one can consistently outperform

explanation.text: The Logic: Strong-form: all info (public + private/insider) is in prices. Insider trading provides no edge. The Trap: Strong form is the most stringent; insider-trading convictions demonstrate it doesn't hold perfectly. Cross-Exam Context: EMH canon. Manager's Pro-Tip: Strong-form is implausible given insider-trading laws exist because insider info DOES matter.
